rules.rule: PROVENANCE DISCLOSURE (PENDING_LIVE_OCA_SCRAPE): Alletra_Storage_System is an unscraped 3-SKU umbrella registry seed kept only for historical continuity. Flagship HPE Alletra Storage MP workloads MUST use the dedicated live-scraped catalogs Alletra_MP_B10000 (Block: Switchless B10100 S0B84A vs. Switched B10200 S1R06A) and Alletra_MP_X10000 (Object/File: S3L12A), following the Ninja Online core sizing -> OCA JSON import -> OCA transceiver/support adaptation workflow.
